title: Public GrowInLove marketing landing page (blush theme) with CTA, carousel, and footer links

requirements.summary: Replace unauthenticated centered login-only welcome screen with a full public marketing landing page, while keeping authenticated app shell unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the app renders a full marketing landing page (not only a login card).
When the user is authenticated, the existing in-app tab UI (Top Bar + BottomNav + tabs) remains unchanged.
Landing page is mobile-first and has a sensible desktop layout variant (responsive).

file_operations.description: Create the public marketing landing page component with responsive (mobile-first) layout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the Landing page into the unauthenticated render path (default), while preserving existing authenticated Top Bar + BottomNav + tab rendering unchanged. Add a deterministic mode switch so unauthenticated users can still reach the existing login/app entry screen when requested.
Extend URL param helpers (non-router) to support a simple landing-vs-app mode switch (e.g., a dedicated query/hash flag) used by App.tsx and the landing CTAs.

requirements.summary: Implement all approved landing sections (header, hero, benefits, carousel, founder story, privacy, optional deep-dives, final CTA, footer) with stable anchor IDs and no testimonials.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page contains: Hero, Benefit Trio (3 blocks), Product Screenshot Carousel, Founder Story, Privacy Reassurance, Optional Feature Deep-dives, Final CTA, Footer.
No testimonials/social proof section is present on the landing page.
Each section is reachable via scroll and has stable anchor IDs suitable for footer navigation (e.g., #about, #contact, etc.).

file_operations.description: Implement the full section structure from the approved wireframe: header (logo + theme toggle), hero, benefits (3 blocks), carousel, founder story, privacy reassurance, optional deep-dives, final CTA, and footer. Ensure each section has stable anchor IDs and explicitly omit testimonials/social proof. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the founder story copy as a single exported constant (sourced from the existing project context) so Landing.tsx can render it consistently and maintainably.

requirements.summary: Add clear landing CTAs: a primary CTA that navigates into the app experience deterministically without a router, and a secondary sign-in CTA that triggers Internet Identity login via existing LoginButton behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The landing page includes a prominent primary CTA button.
Clicking the primary CTA navigates into the app experience (same deployment) in a deterministic way (e.g., hash/query-based mode switch) without breaking the existing tab-based SPA.
A sign-in affordance exists on the landing page and successfully initiates Internet Identity login (reusing existing LoginButton behavior).

file_operations.description: Add a prominent primary CTA that sets/uses the URL mode switch to enter the app experience (same deployment) without introducing a router, plus a secondary CTA that reuses the existing LoginButton to initiate Internet Identity login. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure unauthenticated users who select the app-mode switch see the existing login/app entry experience (not the marketing landing), and that authenticated users still see the in-app shell without changes.

Add an optional prop for clearer landing-page copy/variant (e.g., label override or size) while preserving existing behavior and API compatibility for current in-app usage. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a blush/cream romantic aesthetic to the landing page, fully compatible with existing light/dark theme system and a visible theme toggle in the landing header.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page visually matches a blush/cream romantic design and remains readable and visually coherent in both light and dark modes.
Theme toggle is accessible from the landing page header and correctly switches themes using the existing ThemeProvider/ThemeToggle behavior.
No edits are made to immutable frontend paths; composition/wrapping is used where needed.

file_operations.description: Use the existing ThemeToggle in the landing header and style the landing sections with blush/cream romantic visuals that remain readable in both themes (leveraging existing Tailwind tokens/CSS variables). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add minimal, landing-specific utility classes (e.g., soft gradients, section spacing helpers) that leverage existing CSS variables so both light/dark themes remain coherent. Avoid changes to immutable paths.

requirements.summary: Implement the landing footer with labeled links (About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, and exact investor-interest label) that all navigate to sections or open on-page modals/sheets (no dead links).
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays five text labels: About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, and “Interested in supporting our growth?”.
Clicking About/Contact/Terms/Privacy navigates to a corresponding landing-page section or opens a simple on-page modal/sheet with placeholder content (no dead links).

Investor-interest link label text matches exactly: “Interested in supporting our growth?” and navigates to a corresponding landing-page section or modal with a clear next step (placeholder text is acceptable if no contact endpoint is provided).

file_operations.description: Implement footer with five labeled links. Wire About/Contact to section anchors and implement Terms/Privacy/Investor-interest as on-page modal/sheet content (placeholders allowed) ensuring consistent behavior and exact investor link label text. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small helper component that renders modal/sheet content for Terms, Privacy, and Investor-interest links (placeholder copy), used by Landing.tsx to avoid dead links. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a responsive, performant product screenshot carousel using bundled static images with swipe on mobile and next/prev controls on desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: Carousel renders at least 3 screenshots from frontend static assets and works in both light and dark modes.
On mobile, carousel supports swipe/drag; on desktop, carousel supports next/prev controls.
Images are loaded from the frontend public assets (not fetched from backend).

file_operations.description: Implement a lightweight carousel with pointer/touch swipe/drag support and desktop next/prev controls, rendering static screenshots from frontend public assets and ensuring responsive sizing and performance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add the LandingScreenshotCarousel into the Product Screenshot Carousel section and ensure it is styled appropriately in both light/dark modes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the generated static screenshot asset for the landing carousel (1 of 3).
Add the generated static screenshot asset for the landing carousel (2 of 3).
Add the generated static screenshot asset for the landing carousel (3 of 3).

requirements.summary: Generate and wire new landing-only branding assets (logo icon, wordmark, hero illustration) inspired by the tree-and-hearts image; keep in-app logo usage unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: New generated branding assets exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the landing page.
Landing page header shows the new wordmark/logo assets and the hero section uses the new illustration.
The authenticated in-app shell continues to work and is not visually broken by landing-page asset changes.

file_operations.description: Add the generated landing logo icon asset (transparent background).
Add the generated landing wordmark asset (transparent background).
Add the generated landing hero illustration asset (soft blush palette).

Update landing header to use the new landing-wordmark/logo icon assets, and update the hero section to use the new hero illustration. Ensure these assets are used on the landing page only so the authenticated in-app shell remains unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
